name: meta-ads-ai-analyzer
description: Upload Meta Ads Manager reports and get an AI-powered analysis with actionable recommendations.

scripts.dev: npm run build:core && npm run dev:all
scripts.build: npm run build -w @maa/api && npm run build -w @maa/web

scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run typecheck -w @maa/api && npm run typecheck -w @maa/web
